work.work_result: Assigned essay task 7 to writer node 'write_3' for topic: 'Should social media platforms be held legally responsible for the mental health impacts on users?'

Quality checkpoints established for each essay including thesis clarity, evidence quality, reasoning depth, and counterargument addressing. Each checkpoint will be scored using AP rubric criteria with threshold of 3.5/5 for acceptable quality before moving to next revision cycle.

AP argumentation rubric scoring system implemented with criteria: 1) Claim (1 point), 2) Evidence (2 points), 3) Reasoning (2 points), 4) Organization (1 point), 5) Language (1 point). Scoring scale 0-7. Quality checkpoints established at draft completion, peer review, and final submission stages.

Scheduled review and revision cycles for 34 essays using AP argumentation rubric, including peer review checkpoints, instructor feedback loops, and final quality assurance measures to ensure inter-rater agreement above threshold
